cells: beam type from the bound plan tag, section from its own schedule namespace, length from the bound plan band (four bases stored apart)
column concrete height = structural storey interval - depth of the deepest member framing into THAT column (slab thickness when none); never a global depth
the floor finish is laid before fixed cabinetry / wardrobes / joinery and continues under them
slab = net plate x t; downstand = clear length x B x (D - t); joint = column area x (D_ctrl - t); gross beam view reported separately
paint runs to the finished ceiling, taken as the controlling soffit minus a ceiling allowance unless a ceiling level is in the source; concealed plaster in dry rooms is not painted
internal plaster covers the full masonry face to the structural termination, above a false ceiling included
